objective: A timestamp without a timezone offset is a named correlation defect, never a guessed UTC instant, so this ingest path agrees with the rest of the repository.
decision_supported: Does a naive timestamp mean UTC? No: it means the producer forgot an offset, and guessing made the same event usable here and refused elsewhere.
acceptance: A naive completion time yields OBSERVATION_UNREADABLE_TIME.
A naive observation time yields OBSERVATION_UNREADABLE_TIME.
stop_conditions: The fix would need an event schema change.
risks_and_fallbacks: Tightening this could refuse a producer that was relying on the guess; the failure is named and the fix is on the producer side.
